# cairn identity show

Show a single identity record

## Help

Show a single identity record

Usage: cairn identity show [OPTIONS] <IDENTITY>

Arguments:

Options:

      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>  Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides

  -h, --help                  Print help
